subject: Orchid Health — request for complete prompt/output/log purge (US) and confirmation
messages:
From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@orchidhealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for Orchid Health (US)

Hi Stephanie,

Per our data-retention obligations and an internal audit, we need Redwood to perform a full purge of all prompts, generated outputs, KV cache entries, and related inference logs tied to our org ID ORCH-001 in the US region. Specifically:
- Remove prompt and output artifacts (prompt logs, assistant traces)
- Clear any cached prefix/KV entries related to ORCH-001
- Expunge inference request logs older than 0 days in the live and backup stores for the US region

Please confirm the exact scope you will purge (including backups/snapshots), an expected ETA, and the proof you can provide once the job completes (manifest, checksums, redacted audit log). Legal is CC'd on this email — they may want a signed attestation.

We'd like this completed before EOD Friday Pacific time if possible. Let me know if you need a formal PO or signed authorization.

Thanks,
Sam Jenkins
Head of Product Security
Orchid Health

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Oct 2028 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for Orchid Health (US)

Sam — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Looping in Neha (CS) to confirm authorization and Vivek (Ops) to scope execution.

Internal note: this is priority P2 (customer requested expedite). Neha — can you confirm whether Orchid will sign the standard Data Erasure Attestation (we can accept an email approval if Legal confirms)? Vivek — please advise on ETA if we include backups and GCP snapshots in the sweep. Also advise if we need a maintenance window for low-traffic purge.

I will coordinate the final customer-facing confirmation once we have the manifest and audit stub.

—Stephanie
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Oct 2028 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for Orchid Health (US)

Stephanie / Vivek — thanks. I spoke briefly with Sam and Legal; they are comfortable with an email approval from their Security lead (Sam) for this scope. They asked that we:
1) Provide a scope summary (resources, regions, backup classes)
2) Deliver a CSV manifest listing removed object ids and SHA256 checksums
3) Provide a redacted audit log stub showing the purge job run (timestamps, operator id, job id)

Proposed plan and ETA:
- Open OPS ticket and schedule purge window: within 24 hours of approval.
- Live cluster purge (prompts/outputs/KV): run during low traffic (we can do rolling GC) — estimate 6–8 hours.
- Backup/snapshot sweep: depends on backup class; for standard daily snapshots we'll mark and trigger retention override; estimate 24–48 hours to complete and verify.
- Final verification and manifest generation: 2–4 hours after purge complete.

If that works for Orchid we'll proceed. Sam — please reply to this thread with a one-line approval so we have a record.

Neha Kapoor
Customer Success — Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 04 Oct 2028 23:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full prompt/output/log purge for Orchid Health (US)

Neha / Stephanie — executing per plan. Ticket created: OPS-4321 (link below). Summary of actions performed: 
- Purged prompt and output artifacts from the serving clusters in us-west2 tied to org ORCH-001. Deleted objects include prompt_log_{ORCH-001}_* and output_blob_{ORCH-001}_*.
- Evicted KV cache entries for ORCH-001; confirmed that no active caches remain on serving nodes.
- Initiated backup retention override for daily snapshots (class: standard), started deletion process for affected snapshots. Backups eradication is asynchronous — we'll monitor until complete.

Attached: deletion_manifest_orchid_20281005.csv (list of deleted object ids and SHA256), audit_log_stub_orchid_20281005.txt (redacted job events).

Notes:
- Live cluster deletes are immediate and irreversible.
- Snapshot/backups deletions will surface in our backup system over the next 24–48 hours; I will post completion when the backup system confirms purge.
- No PII was exposed in the audit stub; the manifest contains only object ids and checksums.

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: [deletion_manifest_orchid_20281005.csv (CSV, 48 rows)], [audit_log_stub_orchid_20281005.txt (TXT, redacted)]

Bcc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Orchid Health — purge completed (live cluster) and ongoing backup sweep

Sam — quick update and confirmation:

Thank you for the approval on Wed. Per Vivek's note, the live-cluster purge for ORCH-001 completed successfully on 2028-10-04. We have attached:
- deletion_manifest_orchid_20281005.csv — list of deleted object ids and SHA256 checksums (48 entries)
- audit_log_stub_orchid_20281005.txt — redacted job events showing timestamps, operator id (vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com), and the OPS ticket id (OPS-4321).

Backups/snapshots: the backup subsystem has begun the deletion sweep. We expect final removal from backup storage within 24–48 hours. I will send a brief follow-up when backups report completion; the backup completion will include the final verification record and will be appended to the OPS ticket.

Please let us know if you require a signed attestation. We can generate the standard Data Erasure Attestation PDF and route via DocuSign; that typically takes 1 business day.

If anything looks off in the manifest or audit stub, flag it here and we'll escalate to engineering immediately. Once you confirm receipt and acceptance of the manifest, we'll close OPS-4321.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: deletion_manifest_orchid_20281005.csv, audit_log_stub_orchid_20281005.txt
